connector.name: MCP Server by OilpriceAPI
connector.registryDescription: Source-timestamped energy data and reviewed OilPriceAPI product facts for MCP clients.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package oilpriceapi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oilpriceapi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OILPRICEAPI_KEY
env.description: Your OilPriceAPI key from oilpriceapi.com/signup. Optional: without it, keyless demo mode.

env.name: OILPRICEAPI_MCP_SCOPE
env.description: Tool scope: read (default) or write (explicit mutation opt-in).

env.name: OILPRICEAPI_MCP_PROFILE
env.description: Tool profile: all, core, market, or automation.

env.name: OILPRICEAPI_MCP_CATEGORIES
env.description: Comma-separated category allowlist (core, market, automation) that overrides the profile.
